training_setup.learning_rate_schedule: OneCycle per batch: cosine warm-up 0.01->0.1 over the first 15% of steps, then cosine decay to 1e-5 at epoch 60
training_setup.augmentation: random crop 32x32 with 4-pixel zero padding + random horizontal flip (mixed-precision fp16 training)
training_setup.gpu_used: NVIDIA Tesla T4 (Kaggle), one GPU per run

task3.method: Area under the margin (AUM) from the Task 1 noisy CE run: for each training image, the margin max_{k != y} p_k - p_y (y = noisy label, eval mode, no augmentation) averaged over epochs 1..43 (the early-stop epoch chosen with noisy validation accuracy, i.e. before memorization). Compared against 5-fold cross-validated held-out loss/margin; AUM ranked best.
